race.description: Mcdonald Electrical Fillies And Mares Hcp (Bm62)
race.comment: MULL OF KINTYRE (11) has been saved from a few races lately including when well backed in a Saturday contest. She was fantastic on debut at Echuca back in April, setting up a fast speed and putting gaps back through the field. Jumped out well, possibly they're waiting for a good track but she's got the talent. KIPPIS (7) resumes having been right in the market in all starts to date, winning the maiden at Cranbourne before a spell. Market loves her and she profiles as one who will go on with it. ANNOUNCED SPEED (10) ran on nicely to score on debut at Moe over this trip. Harder now but looks promising, respecting. ICED POPPY (5) can mix form a bit but was good in third here last time and comes back a notch, include.
